ValidationRule.description: SFM-13543: requires product issues when ‘Product Functionality Issues’ is selected as the Cancellation Subreason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.skipValidation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Product Functionality Issues"), ISBLANK(ProductIssues__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Product Issue when ‘Product Functionality Issues’ is selected as the Cancellation Subreason.
